description: HP-66 is the dedicated Regional Transport Office (RTO) for Kullu district in Himachal Pradesh. Unlike sub-divisional RLA offices, this RTO focuses on district-wide transport administration, commercial vehicle permits, and licensing enforcement. It serves as the primary regulatory body for the transport sector within the Kullu valley and surrounding areas.
address: Regional Transport Officer, Kullu District, Kullu, Himachal Pradesh
